thread.title: Energy Hunter Resources appoints Gregory L. Jessup as vice president

title: Energy Hunter Resources appoints Gregory L. Jessup as vice president
text: Energy Hunter Resources appoints Gregory L. Jessup as vice president Staff Writer | Irving, Tx., USA | Tuesday January 23, 2018 6:39AM ET Energy Hunter Resources, an exploration and production company, announced that it has appointed Gregory L. Jessup as vice president of the land department.   Mr. Jessup, prior to joining Energy Hunter Resources, served as CEO of Jessup Energy Land, (Trophy Club, Texas) a petroleum land service company that was specifically created to target and advise in the areas of land, exploration & development, legal, finance and mineral rights aspects of the oil and gas industry. From 2008 to 2016 Mr. Jessup served as the CEO of Jessup Harper Dean, a petroleum land service company based in Plano, Texas. He was also founder and president of Larson Energy, starting that company in 2005 as a purchaser of oil & gas minerals in Oklahoma, eventually expanding the search area to 14 additional States. In 2006 Mr. Jessup was Vice President of Land for Rooster Petroleum, LLC until its corporate relocation from Irving to Houston, Texas. During his tenure, he facilitated the acquisition of working interests in 17 blocks from PetroQuest Energy, Inc. in the Gulf of Mexico shelf. From 1997 to 2005, Mr. Jessup was Vice President of Land for Magnum Hunter Production, Inc. and Gruy Petroleum Management Co. and Vice President of Land – Offshore with Magnum Hunter through its merger with Cimarex Energy Co. in June 2005. Mr. Jessup has been in petroleum land management for more than 30 years. He is a Certified Professional Landman, licensed Real Estate Broker and is a member of numerous professional organizations. He has further held several offices in the American Association of Professional Landmen (AAPL) including Chairman of the Dallas Certified Professional Landman (CPL) Certification Committee Chairman of the Fund Raising Committee for the AAPL Educational Foundation AAPL Director for Dallas and Secretary, AAPL Executive Committee. Mr. Jessup was Director and President of the Texas Energy Council and has served in numerous other positions and associations. LATEST MOVES FROM Texas
